originalHashLocation: imageCompression.ts: sha256Hex(blob), sequential blob.arrayBuffer then crypto.subtle.digest
confirmedOriginalBitmapGap: Original bitmap.close only follows successful context.drawImage; invalid dimensions, missing context and draw failures bypass it.
newBitmapCustody: Adopt actual bitmap before cancellation/dimension checks, release at original draw-success point, attempt cleanup in original invocation finally on early failure, preserve failed handle/cause for retry.
observableCompletion: Await actual arrayBuffer/digest/decode/acquisition/encode/toBlob work and fallback image/reader events; no Promise.race, synthetic worker ACK, invented timer or shared termination.
supportedCancellation: Abort active original FileReader; prevent later stages. Already executing other native work remains awaited.
cleanupFailure: Actual handle and cleanup closure remain retained. Cleanup error history is separate from sanitized census. Local settled remains pending until same-handle successful cleanup retry.
settlementScope: Only original finite invocation and observable local handles. External unknowns remain visible and are excluded from local settled; no business/upload/native-session/application readiness claim.
ownedWorkerOrTimer: none introduced; original hash has no self-created worker
sourceReviewCases: GIF passthrough preserves original File identity
Pre-aborted signal prevents producer start and cleans owned listener
Reader abort only requests actual FileReader.abort; terminal event is still awaited
Cancellation during bitmap decode adopts and cleans actual returned bitmap before checking cancellation
Invalid dimensions, canvas creation/context/draw failures reach original-owned bitmap cleanup
Original close exception remains result failure and is retained in cleanup history; finally retries same original handle
Fallback Image load/error remains awaited before handler/source cleanup
Codec acquisition/encode and canvas-toBlob are awaited without racing cancellation
Original pipeline errors survive cleanup exceptions; failed cleanup keeps settled pending
Cleanup retry only visits failed eligible resources; active native work is not declared releasable
Hash buffer and digest are registered before post-completion cancellation check
Census freezes copies and exposes no input/handle/cause or release permission
Successful encode followed by cancellation reaches the original cancellation boundary outside codec error normalization
